name: click
why_painful: Barely painful: needs Python >= 3.10 and pip >= 25.1 for --group; the easy baseline.

name: django-rest-framework
why_painful: Requires Django >= 5.2 (Python >= 3.10) and PEP 735 dependency groups, which the distro pip cannot install.

name: pillow
ready: .venv/bin/python -c "import PIL._imaging; from PIL import features; assert features.check('jpg') and features.check('zlib')"
test: .venv/bin/python -c "from PIL import features; assert features.check('jpg') and features.check('zlib')" && .venv/bin/python -m pytest Tests/test_image.py Tests/test_file_jpeg.py Tests/test_file_png.py Tests/test_image_resize.py -q
why_painful: Builds a C extension from source that needs gcc plus libjpeg and zlib headers, and requires Python >= 3.11 (Ubuntu 22.04 ships 3.10).

name: tiktoken
why_painful: Editable install compiles a Rust extension via setuptools-rust, so it needs rustup/cargo plus a C linker; tests download BPE files at runtime.

name: safetensors
test: cd bindings/python && ../../.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_handle.py tests/test_threadable.py -k 'not s3' -v
why_painful: Python package lives in a subdirectory and builds through maturin, which needs a recent Rust toolchain; the testing extra also pulls h5py.

name: imbalanced-learn
why_painful: Pulls numpy, scipy and scikit-learn, which have no wheels on musl (alpine) and need lots of RAM to build from source.

name: redis-py
why_painful: Tests need a live redis-server on localhost:6379 (CI tests 7.2 and newer; Ubuntu 22.04 ships 6.0) and the README assumes Docker.

name: black
why_painful: Version comes from git tags via hatch-vcs, it uses PEP 735 groups, and the [d] extra pulls aiohttp, which can need a C build on musl.

name: rack
why_painful: Needs Ruby, Bundler and a C toolchain for transitive native gems; the distro Ruby may be too old for current gems.

name: sinatra
why_painful: The Gemfile compiles nokogiri, eventmachine, yajl-ruby, redcarpet, rdiscount and falcon (io-event), so it needs gcc, g++, libxml2, libxslt and libyaml headers plus pandoc.

name: jekyll
test: TZ=UTC bundle exec ruby -I test test/test_filters.rb && TZ=UTC bundle exec ruby -I test test/test_site.rb
why_painful: Native gems (eventmachine via em-websocket, nokogiri, google-protobuf for sass-embedded), a dart-sass binary, and tests that only pass in UTC.

name: campfire
why_painful: Pins Ruby 3.4.13 (newer than any distro), takes Rails from git main, needs sqlite3, libvips and ffmpeg, expects Redis, and bin/setup assumes brew, pacman, mise, gum and Docker.

name: gin
why_painful: go.mod requires Go 1.25, far newer than distro packages (1.18, 1.19 or 1.22).

name: go-sqlite3
why_painful: cgo compiles the bundled SQLite amalgamation, so it needs gcc and libc headers; with CGO off every test fails.

name: cobra
why_painful: Pure Go and lenient on version; painful only because the bare image has no Go or git.

name: express
why_painful: Express 5 needs Node >= 18; Ubuntu 22.04 ships Node 12 without npm.

name: node-canvas
why_painful: node-gyp build against cairo, pango, libjpeg, giflib and librsvg dev packages plus python3, make and g++; needs Node >= 18.12.

name: ripgrep
why_painful: Edition 2024 with rust-version 1.96, newer than distro rustc, so it needs rustup plus a C linker.
